parameters.query:
SELECT vdc.chunk_text, vd.source_url, vd.title, vd.category_hint, vd.vendor,
       1 - (vde.embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity
  FROM vendor_document_embedding vde
  JOIN vendor_document_chunk vdc ON vdc.chunk_id = vde.chunk_id
  JOIN vendor_document vd ON vd.doc_id = vdc.doc_id
 WHERE vd.is_active = true
   AND ($2 = '' OR vd.vendor ILIKE $2)
 ORDER BY vde.embedding <=> $1::vector
 LIMIT $3::int;
